text:
Alex: opened PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8602 — microbatch allocator tweak. ran a quick canary smoke, saw a p95 tail bump on 4k longseq. bench here: https://bench.redwood.ai/artifacts/8602/e2e-smoke-2026-03-17.html

Jia: can you paste a before/after table and memory numbers? which bench config? :eyes:

Alex: before p95(4k)=220ms, after=234ms (+6.4%). mem p95 +80MB. config: microbatch=8, prefill=true. cmd: `./bench/run.sh --profile e2e --seq 4096 --batch 8`

Sam: is that from canary or local single-host? if across canary that's more concerning. any throughput falloff?

Alex: this is canary. throughput ~unchanged (~1% drop, noise). tail up on longseq workloads — visible in user traces.

InfraBot: Canary analysis: 6/12 hosts show similar p95 delta, 2/12 hosts show >10% tail bump. snapshot: https://canary.redwood.ai/snapshots/8602

Maria: can we collect pprof/top for the bad hosts and kv-cache hit rates? suspect prefill path interacting with allocator locks.

Jia: also try a run with `--prefill=false` and microbatch=4 to narrow it down.

Alex: uploaded pprof (top flame): https://perf.redwood.ai/pprof/8602/20260317/top.pb.gz
kv log excerpt from high-tail host:
``
kv_cache.hit_rate: 0.87
kv_cache.prefill_hit: 0.12
allocator.lock_wait_avg_ms: 0.9
allocator.lock_wait_p95_ms: 6.2
```

Sam: allocator.lock_wait_p95 ~6ms + extra prefill work could explain tail. if prefill holds locks while doing KV ops that's a red flag.

Maria: can we add per-path lock hold instrumentation? if repro is consistent we should hold the merge. Sam — want to take this?

Sam: I'll take it. will run a narrow repro with `--prefill=false` and `--microbatch=4` and post pprof/top. marking PR hold.

Alex: added `hold/merge` label, paused canary. ping me if you need the canary unpaused for more runs.

deploy-bot: snapshot 8602 created (sha: abc123...), canary status: PAUSED

Jia: thanks. paste the small-batch numbers when you have them. if it's isolated to prefill path we can attempt a localized change.

Sam: quick update — local narrow repro: prefill=false p95 ~221ms -> 223ms (tiny); prefill=true 220ms -> 234ms. microbatch=4 reduces delta to ~3ms. looks like batching+prefill interaction. uploading new bench links shortly.

Alex: that's helpful. leaves it to Sam to debug. tagging @Maria for priority. :thumbsup:

Maria: ack. agree to keep merge on hold until we have root cause and either a small fix or rollback plan.

Sam: plan: try reordering prefill to do KV lookups outside allocator critical section, add short instrumentation for lock-hold per code path, then run canary. ETA EOD.

Alex: thanks — added a short reproduction README and run commands to the PR.

Sam: posting bench artifacts and pprof when available. will summarize delta and proposed fix in a follow-up comment.

Jia: once we have a small patch we can consider a targeted canary with a subset of longseq traffic to validate.

Alex: noted. leaving canary paused until Sam gives a thumbs-up.

Maria: thanks team. if anyone finds more hosts with >10% tail bump call it out here.
